generic_pow_bug.cause: A supported one-worker scoped pool entered the BLAKE2s grinder whose worker_count>=2 assertion is an optimizer assumption. ReleaseFast reached uninitialized PowWork (stride0,best_index null) and crashed.
generic_pow_bug.fix: Dispatch coordinator-only BLAKE2s to canonical grindWithWorkerCount(bits,1); BLAKE3 to canonical serial grind. Preserve pooled paths at >=2 workers and explicit PoW worker overrides.
generic_pow_bug.regression: Both channels, difficulties0/8/12/16, canonical nonce validity and transcript continuation; q70/P26 K native single/multi-worker identical proofs.
generic_pow_bug.classification: Generic correctness/resource-policy fix, not a Keccak speedup claim.

remaining: Immutable domain-only preprocessing v2, CPU emitter integration and authenticated RAM hash boundary remain required.
